title: #120 Technology
prompt: Technology allows us to have a helpful and interesting life than in the past. Do you agree or disagree?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology makes daily life much simpler for people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology makes daily life much simpler for people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology improves how people talk to each other.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology improves how people talk to each other.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology makes daily life hard for many people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology makes daily life hard for many people.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology also takes away important human skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology also takes away important human skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology improves communication methods, allowing people to connect globally and maintain relationships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology improves communication methods, allowing people to connect globally and maintain relationships.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology provides better access to information and learning, enabling people to gain knowledge and skills from anywhere.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology provides better access to information and learning, enabling people to gain knowledge and skills from anywhere.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Excessive screen time and preference for online activities over face-to-face interaction can hinder the development of real social skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Excessive screen time and preference for online activities over face-to-face interaction can hinder the development of real social skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology, particularly social media, can negatively impact mental health by encouraging social comparison and feelings of unhappiness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology, particularly social media, can negatively impact mental health by encouraging social comparison and feelings of unhappiness.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: To explore how technology has transformed daily life, making it more convenient and interesting, while addressing potential counterarguments.
keyArguments: Technology has made daily tasks more efficient and enjoyable through innovations like smartphones and the internet.
While technology brings many benefits, it also raises concerns about over-reliance and the need for balanced usage.
